subject: Complete an in-range entity seek before refreshing its stale route
description: Schema-12 representative `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_001/replay-012-session-0001.jsonl.zst` formerly first diverged after frame 3240 on PC126: Original selected animation 8 / `HitCmd` with wait time 0, while Rust retained animation 6 / `MoveOk` and rearmed wait time 25. PC126 was at `(1840,537)` and live target Soldier63 at `(1863.42041015625,523.8768310546875)` in sector 54, giving squared distance about 720, below the actor's live `32^2 * 1.1025` interaction threshold; only the installed route destination and `last_seek_target_position` were stale. Original ordinary entity `RHElementActor::PerformSeek` computes the live target or `USE_POINT` vector, applies directional Y stretch when requested, then tests strict same-sector `fSquareNorm < mfSeekDistance * mfSeekDistance * 1.1025` and starts the post-seek sequence before its out-of-range branch can test the expired wait and greater-than-10 MaxNorm displacement (`original-code/RHelementactor.cpp:7285-7328,7346-7414`). The PC `RHMOVE_SEEK_SHIELD` arm is deliberately different and retains its earlier refresh check (`original-code/RHelementactor.cpp:7330-7345`). Rust's pre-owner refresh scan had run the stale-route check first and replaced the seek before movement Execute could launch Hit. Commit `0d828d811663bde758efa60b59fed8df2c29339a` adds the source-ordered live-tolerance guard for ordinary entity seeks while excluding the shield arm. The focused `terminal_pc_hit_in_live_range_precedes_expired_stale_seek_refresh` regression sets an expired timer, a target displaced more than 10 units from the saved route, and a live target inside interaction range; it proves no replacement or 25-frame rearm occurs and that Hit launches, and passes 1/1. The authoritative optimized runner was `/home/phire/robinhood/target/parity/examples/original_parity_replay`, built from base HEAD `7b5001e93` plus coordinated frozen diff `db28559b…` containing the exact production patch, with SHA-256 `a302025592f5769ebc0869b3983cfe9dcb647f97b800c244de2af73c1f55233d`, size 65,882,909 bytes, and mtime `2026-08-11 16:03:48.187951284 +0200`. It matches the representative and same-save controls `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_001/replay-011-session-0001.jsonl.zst` and `parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/traces/Savegame_linux3/Profile_001/Savegame_001/replay-001-session-0001.jsonl.zst` through exact EOF, all with exit status 0. Scoped formatting and diff checks pass; committed scope is exactly `crates/robin_engine/src/engine/refresh_seek.rs` and `crates/robin_engine/src/engine/movement.rs`.
